title: Oracle WebLogic Commons DiskFileItem Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Oracle WebLogic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the use of Apache Commons DiskFileItem. It is possible to execute arbitrary commands upon deserialization of untrusted data. The attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the process.
